description: energy-floor gate at default silenceThreshold=0.005 -- a 30 Hz bass tone (raw i16 sine, amplitude_short=1000, a LITERAL derived offline from 32767 -- not from the production VAD_RMS_NORMALIZATION_DIVISOR constant, so a reverted divisor cannot cancel out against this fixture's own derivation). Raw (unfiltered) normalized RMS is ~0.0216 -- comfortably ABOVE both the default (0.005) and tuned (0.02) thresholds -- but the 85 Hz Butterworth highpass attenuates 30 Hz to ~12% passthrough, so the production-seam filtered RMS is ~0.0027, BELOW threshold. This makes the highpass filter load-bearing for this vector: removing it, or reverting the Silero/RMS input to the unfiltered frame, flips expected_gate_open from false to true.

energy-floor gate at default silenceThreshold=0.005 -- at threshold (>= semantics). Signal: a Nyquist-frequency square wave (raw i16 samples alternating +amplitude_short/-amplitude_short every sample). amplitude_short=164 is a LITERAL precomputed offline as ceil(0.005 * 32767) -- not derived from the production VAD_RMS_NORMALIZATION_DIVISOR constant at test time. A 2nd-order Butterworth highpass has EXACT unity gain at Nyquist, so the production-seam filtered RMS (~0.005005) lands within quantization noise of 0.005 -- far smaller than the 0.001 gap to the neighboring vectors, resolving to gate-open under the shared >= semantics.

energy-floor gate at default silenceThreshold=0.005 -- above threshold. Same Nyquist-square-wave construction as VAD-GATE-002; amplitude_short=197 is a LITERAL precomputed offline as ceil(0.006 * 32767).

energy-floor gate at a tuned silenceThreshold=0.02 -- just below threshold. Same Nyquist-square-wave construction as VAD-GATE-002; amplitude_short=623 is a LITERAL precomputed offline as ceil(0.019 * 32767).

energy-floor gate at a tuned silenceThreshold=0.02 -- at threshold (>= semantics). Same Nyquist-square-wave construction as VAD-GATE-002; amplitude_short=656 is a LITERAL precomputed offline as ceil(0.02 * 32767).

energy-floor gate at a tuned silenceThreshold=0.02 -- above threshold. Same Nyquist-square-wave construction as VAD-GATE-002; amplitude_short=689 is a LITERAL precomputed offline as ceil(0.021 * 32767).
stop-latency (frames-to-stop) at default silenceSecs=2.0 -- ceil(2.0 * 31.25) = 63 (AC6); above the AC2 7-frame floor
stop-latency at a tuned silenceSecs=0.5 -- ceil(0.5 * 31.25) = 16; still above the AC2 7-frame floor
stop-latency at a very small tuned silenceSecs=0.05 -- exercises the AC2 200ms-equivalent floor (ceil(0.05 * 31.25) = 2, floored up to 7)
